summary: PDF-blank-bug fix VERIFIED. Removing 'noopener,noreferrer' from window.open() in /app/frontend/src/utils/invoicePdf.ts:595 successfully resolves the blank popup issue diagnosed in iteration_10. Popups now open with fully rendered invoice HTML: GST Invoice popup body=1498 chars (title='Tax Invoice TB-0001'), Kacha Bill popup body=633 chars (title='Kacha Bill CM-0001'). doc.write(html) now executes because window.open() returns a valid window handle. Independent counters TB-0001 (GST) and CM-0001 (Kacha) both incremented from the initial 0001 seed state, confirming save flow is unaffected. All five iteration_10 tests now pass. NOTE: Testing had to re-seed data (AsyncStorage was empty at start of run) — the shop-config save button click in the test script could not find the exact save testid (test-setup limitation, not app bug), so the popup renders with default 'Your Tyre Shop' name instead of 'Sri Krishna Tyres'. This does NOT affect the core fix verification — the popups populate with correct HTML content, which is the exact bug that was being fixed.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (previously identified in iter_10): windowFeatures 'noopener,noreferrer,...' passed to window.open() forces the return to null per HTML spec — subsequent doc.write() never ran → blank tab. FIX APPLIED: Removed 'noopener,noreferrer' — window.open() now returns a live handle. VERIFICATION: This iteration ran the same TEST A/B/C/D/E flow. Both popups now open with populated HTML (1498 & 633 chars). No pageerrors. Bug closed.
